the Pen's discipline of high collars and habits clung to resident mages well after graduation

Combined with a miniskirt, bronze high heels, and gold nails cast from melted Ethons, Agness's look defied every foundation of CISAME—where students were obliged to wear the prescribed colors and cut, and where the Pen's discipline of high collars and habits clung to resident mages well after graduation, straight to gray hair and the grave.

Because, exams aside, it was the curators who decided whether a student was worthy of advancing to the fifth-circle to pursue a magical specialty—and who guided a mage's path all the way to expulsion or graduation.
A battle magess, a veteran, Agness lacked even a fifth-circle diploma—and rumor had it she hadn't even served her full ten years as a battle magess.
